title: Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana (PMSSY) Policy & Guidelines

nodes.title: 1. Programme Overview & Type
nodes.content:
Programme Name: Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana (PMSSY)
Jurisdiction: India
Category: Public healthcare infrastructure
Type: Public Healthcare Infrastructure
Details: Programme focused on correcting regional imbalances in tertiary healthcare and improving medical education through institutions such as AIIMS and upgraded government medical colleges.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria & Conditions
nodes.content:
Eligibility: Not an individual enrolment-based insurance benefit. Patients access services at participating institutions under institution-specific rules.
Individual Enrolment Required: False

nodes.title: 3. Required Documents & Documentation
nodes.content: Required Documents: Hospital registration documents and clinical records as required by the treating institution; no general scheme beneficiary card.

nodes.title: 4. Application Procedure & Access Desks
nodes.content:
Where to Apply / Access: Contact the relevant participating AIIMS or upgraded government medical college for patient registration and service details.
Official Portal: https://pmssy.mohfw.gov.in/
